pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-07-17. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-07-17 at 2,129.22 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 10.16 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 2,068 million. The top gainer of the week was Mlima Cement (SYN).

Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures.
